::: {#def-rmse}
#### Root mean squared error

The **root mean squared error** of an estimator $\hparam$
is the square root of its [mean squared error](#def-mse):

$$\operatorname{RMSE}\paren{\hparam} \eqdef \sqrt{\mselr{\hparam}}$$

It has the same units as the estimand.
In @exm-mse-sample-mean,
the root mean squared error of $\bar X$ is $\sdpar/\sqrt{n}$.
:::
